Safety & Clean-Up

Safe by design, clean by default

The console is built to be trusted around paws, snouts and enthusiastic play.

  • Chew-Proof & Cordless

    No exposed cords for curious chewers. The battery-powered console sits safely on the floor.

  • Dishwasher-Safe Chambers

    Pop-out chambers rinse clean while every surface stays food-safe and secured.

  • All-Day Battery + USB-C

    Recharges via USB-C and runs multiple days on a single charge.

    Every surface your dog touches is food-safe and non-toxic.
